items.title: Why the deep summary matters
items.light_summary: A comparison of two caching strategies.
items.deep_summary: Full walk-through of both caching strategies with their failure modes. The write-through approach is simpler but couples latency to the slowest store; the write-behind approach hides latency but needs a recovery path after a crash. The author recommends write-through until measurements say otherwise.
